decision.explanation: The query asks for the release date of the album 'Girls' Generation'. The source documents present two distinct entities with this name: 'Girls' Generation (2007 album)' and 'Girls' Generation (2006 album)'. Document D1 explicitly states the 2007 album was released on November 1, 2007. Document D2 explicitly states the 2006 album was released on January 1, 2006. As the prompt instructs to keep supported alternate referents and distinct valid namesakes coexist, both dates are returned as valid answers corresponding to their respective specific albums.
